name: Mahbubnagar

queries.query: Mahbubnagar Telangana official cadastral parcel map GIS land records portal
queries.result: Found the official Telangana TGRAC Land Information System ArcGIS REST service and the official Mahabubnagar district land-records page. The TGRAC service has a public Mahabubnagar village cadastral-unit layer, but no Mahabubnagar land-parcel polygon sublayer.

queries.query: మహబూబ్ నగర్ తెలంగాణ భూ పటం కాడాస్ట్రల్ మ్యాప్ అధికారిక పోర్టల్
queries.result: Search surfaced the official Telangana Bhu Bharati GIS viewer and Mahabubnagar district survey/land-records page. The Bhu Bharati GIS page timed out during the bounded anonymous fetch; no login or credentials were attempted.

administrativeIdentity.identityEvidence: Official TGRAC layer metadata and bounded query attributes use District=Mahabubnagar; this is a district GIS identity, not a confirmation that the WUP point lies inside a returned parcel.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: TGRAC Land Information System service covers Telangana cadastral reference layers and a Mahabubnagar village-cadastral-unit layer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public polygon layer metadata and bounded queries were verified; no Mahabubnagar parcel-polygon sublayer was exposed in the service directory.
coverageAssessment.exactPointHitInterpretation: The exact WUP point query returned zero features; this is only a bounded map hit-test result and is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.

technicalBlocker: The public TGRAC service exposes Mahabubnagar village cadastral-unit polygons, not a Mahabubnagar land-parcel polygon layer. The Bhu Bharati GIS viewer fetch timed out.
remainingUncertainty: No safe native parcel identity plus full parcel polygon was verified near the WUP point. Nearby returned records are cadastral-unit records and were not retained as parcel samples.
nextStep: A serial reviewer may inspect the current Bhu Bharati viewer or another first-party Telangana parcel endpoint independently; runtime admission remains held.
